test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

By next summer, they will be _____ their house.
solution:
The correct answer is '**renovating**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• The verb "**renovating**" is in the future continuous tense, which is appropriate for actions that will be ongoing at a specific time in the future. 
 
• The sentence refers to an action that will be taking place by "**next summer**," so the future continuous tense "**will be renovating**" is required.
